subject: general
question: Find the value of sqrt {{{2k}} {{ + }} {{11}}}, where k is average of 16, 25, 13, 26 and 15.
solution:
Given:

k is average of 16, 25, 13, 26 and 15

Concept used:

Total = Mean (Average) × number of entities

Calculation:

Average of 16, 25, 13, 26 and 15 = Sum (16, 25, 13, 26, 15) ÷ 5 = 19

Hence,

sqrt {{{2k}} {{ + }} {{11}}}

⇒ sqrt {{{2 times 19}} {{ + }} {{11}}}

⇒ {sqrt49}

⇒ 7

∴ The value of sqrt {{{2k}} {{ + }} {{11}}} is 7.
